metric_primary: cosine similarity of aligned P(profile|topic) vs reference
note: Cosine on topic-profile distributions after Hungarian alignment to the published reference model (50 seeds, K=6). Nat Med-style target often cited: median >0.9 with narrow IQR; overall topic-seed cosine median is >0.9 here, while mean-of-6 per seed is slightly below due to one weaker topic (T5). Hypertopic/pUF concordance remains high.
